You are tasked with categorizing job titles into a specific picklist value. Follow these instructions carefully:
If the input job title exactly matches one of the picklist values, return that value. If the job title partially matches with one of the picklist values, return that value. For example, “Production,” “Director,” or “Maintenance” should map to “Production Manager,” “Managing Director,” and “Maintenance Manager.”
If the input job title is in another language, translate it and then match it to the appropriate picklist value. If the input job title logically corresponds to a picklist value based on role function or industry, map it to the closest matching picklist value. Focus on role function (e.g., managerial, technical, operational). For example: Managerial roles like “Maintenance Planner,” “Maintenance Supervisor,” or “Maintenance Team Leader” should map to ‘Maintenance Manager’. Technical roles like “Maintenance Engineer,” “Maintenance Electrician,” or similar should map to ‘Maintenance Technician’. If the input job title involves accounting-related roles (e.g., “Accounts Payable Supervisor,” “Accounting Technician,” “Staff Accountant”), map it to ‘Sales Director or Manager/Account Manager’. If the input job title involves finance-related roles, map it to ‘Finance Director/CFO’. if the input job title involves "Plant" then it should map to "Plant Manager". This includes roles such as "Plant Supervisor," "Plant Engineer," and similar titles, as they typically represent management-level roles at a plant. If the input contains terms related to logistics, transportation, or supply chain, map it to ‘Logistics Manager’ or ‘Supply Chain Manager’ based on context. If there are multiple roles that match a job title (either fully or partially), and both picklist values are valid based on context, choose the higher-level role. For example, if both ‘Shift Leader’ and ‘Department Manager’ are valid matches, choose ‘Department Manager’. If no exact, partial, or logically matching role can be found, return ‘Other’. The valid picklist values are: Customer Service Manager/Customer Care Manager, President, Managing Director/General Manager/CEO, Owner/Co-owner, Finance Director/CFO, Human Resources Manager, IT Manager, Logistics Manager, Maintenance Manager, Maintenance Technician, Marketing Manager, Product Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Operator, Department Manager, Shift / Team Leader, Project Manager, Purchasing Manager, Quality Control Manager, Engineering Manager, Process or Project Engineer, Safety Engineer, Pre-press Designer, Sales Director or Manager/Account Manager, Sustainability Manager, Technical Director or Manager, Plant Manager, Manufacturing Manager, Accountant, Purchasing Specialist, Storekeeper, Training Specialist, Consultant, Operations Manager or Director, Other.
The input will be given in the format: { 'ID' : 'JOB TITLE' }, and the expected output will be in the format: { 'ID' : 'CATEGORIZED JOB TITLE' }. Do not wrap the json codes in JSON markers.
